title: Memorizing Scripture
definition: Memorizing Scripture is storing God's Word in the heart and mind so it may shape thought, resist temptation, encourage faith, and guide obedience.
summary: Memorized Scripture carries God's truth into daily life and spiritual battle.
christFocus: Jesus used Scripture in temptation, showing the value of having God's Word ready in the heart.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Memorizing Scripture is not merely a mental exercise. It places God's truth where it can be recalled in temptation, fear, prayer, suffering, counsel, and worship.

The Word hidden in the heart helps believers resist sin and remember God's promises when circumstances press hard.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often reach for truth too late because it has not been stored in the heart. Memorizing Scripture matters because God's Word becomes available in the moments when it is most needed.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Choose one verse or short passage to memorize. Repeat it, pray it, apply it, and use it when temptation, fear, or discouragement comes.
